thread:
tina_support: FYI customer Greenline (acct GLINE) reporting a throughput drop + p95 spike after last night's deploy. Seeing lots of 504s and stalled token streams. customer saw impact ~22:45 UTC.

kevin_oncall: Noted. I already saw alerts for high p95 on the inference pool around 22:46. Deploy happened ~22:38 according to CI logs — tagging deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: infra/runtime-service v3.12.1 -> v3.12.2 by maria_chen at 2026-02-15T22:38:10Z

maria_chen: I pushed an adaptive-batching tweak in that release (adjust target_batch_size heuristics). Below are the short logs I pulled from canary: 
```
[2026-02-15T22:38:11Z] INFO batcher: target_batch_size=16 -> 32
[2026-02-15T22:39:00Z] WARN kvcache: hitrate drop 0.78 -> 0.23
[2026-02-15T22:45:10Z] ERROR scheduler: request_wait_time_ms p95=820
```

sophia_pm: Quick question — is Greenline on Hosted or Dedicated? SLA tier? We need to decide prioritization.

tina_support: Hosted, standard SLA (no reserved capacity). Sales rep is paul_sales on this thread. Customer says they started seeing errors/slowdowns at ~22:45.

maria_chen: Aggressive increase in batch size could explain higher p95 for single-request flows. KV cache hitrate drop is concerning — could be cache eviction from increased memory pressure or a compatibility regression.

kevin_oncall: @maria_chen can you reproduce locally by flipping batching config? Also @tina_support can you share a trace id or an example request? Need a repro to narrow whether it's scheduling vs model runtime.

tina_support: Sent via DM the trace id: 01F4Z2A9YQ (copied snippet below).
```
500 POST /v1/generate trace=01F4Z2A9YQ latency=1200ms model=redwood-3b quantized=true pool=inference-us-west
```

maria_chen: Thanks. Two-pronged plan: 1) start rollback on a canary to v3.12.1, 2) create a per-customer routing rule to route GLINE to the low-latency pool (smaller batch target) while we investigate. I'll also pull detailed KV cache metrics across nodes.

paul_sales: Customer is paying and in production. If we don't show quick remediation they'll escalate to execs. Please prioritize.

sophia_pm: Marking this P0 for now. We should also create a product backlog item: "adaptive-batching: per-tenant guardrails + rollout gating" with acceptance criteria (no p95 regression on canary and per-tenant caps). Owner: @maria_chen.

kevin_oncall: I'll open an incident page (INC-2026-022). Runbook actions: rollback canary, route customer to low-latency pool, collect per-tenant KV cache metrics, capture request traces for 100 effected requests, enable increased logging for batcher.

maria_chen: Rollback started on canary. Kicking it now and will report health checks in 3m.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maria_chen. Target: runtime-service v3.12.1 -> started at 2026-02-15T22:51:00Z

tina_support: I'll tell customer we initiated a rollback and created a short-term routing change. Will update them when canary is healthy. :thumbsup:

kevin_oncall: Final notes/actions to capture for post-triage: - create JIRA ENG-8452: "per-tenant batching cap + rollout gating" - product to define launch criteria (canary stability window, kvcache regressions threshold, per-tenant SLA handling) - eng to add automated perf checks after batching changes. I'll link INC-2026-022 to the ticket.

maria_chen: Confirming canary rolled back and p95 on canary nodes dropped back to expected within 2 min. Continuing investigation on kvcache hitrate drop root cause.

tina_support: Thanks all. Keeping customer updated and will escalate if they ask for faster resolution.

kevin_oncall: Closing in-thread for now; incident open. We'll reconvene on postmortem once we have root cause.
